purpose: Implement canonical cross-platform process identity plus an atomic per-profile application-instance lease so N0TE can enforce single-instance ownership without PID-only identity, OS-specific priority, force-killing, or stealing a lease whose owner liveness is uncertain.

lineage.outcome: A consumer N0TE profile can have one truthfully identified application owner across peer macOS, Windows and Linux semantics; crashes can be recovered only from verified-dead ownership while live or uncertain owners are never stolen.
lineage.capability: Cross-platform process identity and fail-closed single-instance lease

legacy_rejections: macOS process model as universal law

completion_proof: ProcessIdentity combines canonical platform/architecture, positive PID and hashed opaque process-start token; PID reuse with a different start token is different identity
PLATFORM-00A macOS, Windows and Linux state roots map the same semantic per-profile lease reference
first atomic acquire has exactly one winner and same exact process acquire is idempotent
foreign verified ALIVE ownership returns HELD_BY_OTHER and leaves the lease unchanged
foreign UNKNOWN ownership returns UNCERTAIN and leaves the lease unchanged
only verified DEAD ownership may be archived and replaced, returning REPLACED_STALE with exact previous lease receipt
takeover re-reads and re-probes the exact current owner before replacement so DEAD→ALIVE/UNKNOWN changes cancel takeover
interrupted takeover can resume for the same exact process before or after stale archival; live/unknown foreign takeover markers remain fail-closed and a verified-dead marker cannot block forever
release requires exact current process fingerprint and lease nonce
malformed, tampered or symlink lease state fails visibly
profile isolation and opaque profile path validation hold; manager requires an absolute state root and does not depend on cwd
next_selection_rule: After PLATFORM-00B evidence, reconcile and globally compare remaining shared PLATFORM-00 process/security/package/audio/plugin-worker chassis against DAW-00, OPS-04 and any newly unblocked application work. Do not make macOS chronology the platform roadmap.
